log.msg: THE OWNER'S OWN USE, END TO END, WORKED. I wanted a docs browser I click through as columns with a properties panel on the right, dense type, tinted page - not one of the twelve presets. Set seven dropdowns on the hub: all seven took. The address became ?navigation=columns&arrangement=rail-right&content=docs&background=tint&type=compact. Opened that url in a FRESH browser context: identical stage classes (paging-bg-tint paging-type-compact paging-room-wide paging-arr-rail-right paging-nav-columns), identical seven dropdown values, identical 698x561 canvas, zero console errors. Pressed More, pressed 'Make this a page': public/imagine/paging/made/paging/page.json appeared on disk with my seven words, and /imagine/paging/make/paging/ opens cold with those words and its own bar, zero errors. Deleted it after; made/ is byte-identical to where I started.

BREAK FOUND, and it is the button the fix pass just promoted. Press Code - tooltip 'the page.js this page would be, ready to copy' - and 'THE SAME PAGE, AS CODE' is a dark strip 22px tall (27px at 3440) whose content is 352px and 19 lines. You see half of line one. The JSON box under 'THIS PAGE, AS A FILE' is the same: 22px tall, 282px of content, 15 lines, and scrollW 536 inside a 280px box so it scrolls sideways too. Both are pre.code-block inside .drawer-body flex v - a flex child with no min-height, collapsed. Measured at 1280 and 3440, on Code and on More.

COLD WALK CLEAN. 25 pages x 1280 and 3440 = 50 loads: zero console errors except the known readme probe 404, zero sideways scroll, zero literal asterisks, every page has an active-page. Fix 6 held everywhere I could measure: the stage box is 95-97 percent painted on every page that has one, at both widths (2634/2739 at 3440, 895/927 at 1280) - the 720-in-2739 first folds are gone.

log.msg: RE-CHECKED MY SIX VISIT-3 ITEMS. (1) The two page.json schemas are ONE: Build's live file panel now prints navigation/content/room/arrangement/surface/background/type - fixed. (2) Build's step 4 is ARRANGEMENT with all seven values (Plain, Toolbar top, Footer, Panel left, Panel right, Main + aside, Wall) - fixed. (3) The drawer's arrangement sentences read 'Inside the box the blocks are one column - layout 1.stack' - fixed. (4) Code and More are two different drawers: 'THE SAME PAGE, AS CODE' is 215px down for Code and 1567px down for More - fixed. (5) Library's grey chip-button is a labelled PAGE SHAPE dropdown reading the running preset - fixed. STILL OPEN from that list: /navigation/ is still the one block page with no stage and no bar, and Make's rows at 3440 are still 2847px wide with the title box 2299px and the four word chips starting at x2851 - a page's name and the words describing it are 2300px apart on one row.

BUILD'S SEVENTH STEP DROPS FIVE OF THE SEVEN WORDS, proven live. Pressed Tint and Panel right on /build/: the JSON on the right became surface tint / arrangement rail-right, and the page.js under '7 Code' did not change one character - it prints title/icon/description/width/children/content and none of navigation, surface, arrangement, room or type (build/words.js code_for_node). The one word it does print is width: "large" - core's word, which this realm calls Room = Wide and never teaches. Meanwhile the drawer's code_for_config prints all seven. Two 'as code' outputs in one realm, one complete and one lossy.

WHAT BOUNDS 'INFINITE POTENTIAL', concretely. Three closed lists. The nest takes a PRESET ID, so the twelve ready-made pages are the only things that can go inside a page - the page I made myself cannot, which is the owner's sentence 'put any page inside any other' unmet. Cross is a hard-coded 3x3 with no control, out of the 7x7 the two vocabularies allow. Content is eight fixed renderers with no way to point the stage at a page you wrote. So the realm is 6x7x8x4x5x5x3 = 100,800 arrangements of the SAME eight contents: large, and closed.

ALSO PROVEN GOOD: 'Copy this link' puts the exact address on the clipboard and the box matches location.href character for character; ?nest=dashboard alone runs a whole dashboard page inside the box under a dashed rule reading 'A WHOLE PAGE, RUNNING INSIDE THIS BOX'.
SIX WORDS, fourth visit (delta from visit 3: 3/5/5/4/4/3). simple 3 -> 4. powerful 5 -> 5. organized 5 -> 5. intuitive 4 -> 4. easy to browse 4 -> 5. infinite potential 3 -> 3.

WHY EACH. simple 4: the two page.json schemas became one and I can prove it, but a newcomer still reads three sets of names - the rail's six blocks, the bar's seven labels (Skin is three of them, Stage is none), and the url's surface/background/type where the controls say content colour/page colour/type size. easy to browse 5: 25 pages x 1280 and 3440, every stage box 95-97 percent painted, no sideways scroll, no errors, every page one click from the rail - the 720-in-2739 first folds are gone. intuitive 4, held off 5 by two things a label promises and does not deliver: Code lands on a code box showing one line of nineteen, and 'Make this a page' names your page after the page you were standing on and never links to it. infinite potential 3: unchanged, and bounded by three closed lists (nest = twelve preset ids, cross = a fixed 3x3, content = eight renderers).

WHAT WOULD MOVE THE TWO THE BRIEF ASKS ABOUT. simple to 5 is a naming pass, no new behaviour: one SKIN group holding the three skin controls so the bar's labels are the rail's names, one line on Stage saying it has no control because it IS the box, and url keys that match the labels. infinite potential to 5 is two seams: ?nest= takes a URL instead of a preset id, so any page - including one you just made - goes inside any other, which is the owner's sentence verbatim; and /cross/ gets two dropdowns for which word crosses which, so one page draws 49 pictures nobody chose one by one instead of 9 that somebody did.

WORSE THAN VISIT 3, one thing. At visit 3 my complaint was that Code and More opened the same drawer and the code sat below its fold. The fix pass made Code open ON the code - and the box it opens on is 22px tall holding 352px and 19 lines. So the button whose tooltip reads 'the page.js this page would be, ready to copy' now puts half of one line in front of you. The promise got louder while the thing behind it stayed broken.

FIX LIST, ranked. 1 The drawer's two code boxes show one line of nineteen - /imagine/paging/ press Code - pre.code-block is a flex child of .drawer-body flex v with no min-height, so it collapses to 22px (scrollH 352, scrollW 536 in a 280px box); give it flex: none and let it scroll itself - S. 2 Make's rows cannot be read at 3440 - /imagine/paging/make/ - .paging-make-title grows to 2299px so a page's name sits 2300px from its four word chips; cap the row at the reading measure - S. 3 'Make this a page' names your page after the page you were standing on - the drawer - it took the hub's title, icon and description, so I got a second page called Paging, and the 'Saved to disk' line links Make's list rather than the new page's own url; add a title field and link /imagine/paging/make/<name>/ - S. 4 Build's step 7 drops five of the seven words - /imagine/paging/build/ - code_for_node prints title/icon/description/width/children only, and says width: "large" where the realm says Room = Wide; print the seven the way the drawer's code_for_config does - M. 5 One name per thing, from the rail to the address bar - everywhere - group the three skin controls under one SKIN label and make the url keys the label words - M. 6 The nest can only hold one of twelve - the drawer, ?nest= - it takes a preset id, so a page you made cannot go inside anything; take a url - M. 7 Cross is a fixed 3x3 out of 7x7 - /imagine/paging/cross/ - two dropdowns for which word crosses which - M. 8 Navigation is the one block page with no bar - /imagine/paging/navigation/ - the page for the word navigation is the only one where you cannot change the navigation word; put the standard stage and bar under its two comparison cards - S. 9 The bar centres at 3440 (760px of white each side) and left-aligns at 1280 (40px) - /imagine/paging/ - pick one - S, cosmetic.

COVERAGE AND HYGIENE. 25 pages x 1280 and 3440 = 50 cold loads, plus the use flow, the drawer probe at both widths on both buttons, Build driven live, the nest url, and the clipboard. Zero console errors anywhere except the known readme probe 404. Private server 8098 (node pid 38072), killed by pid. Nothing under public/imagine/ was edited; the one page I made with Make was deleted and made/ is byte-identical by md5 to where I started.

assign.outcome:
**Fourth visit. I used the realm the way you said you wanted to — wanted a page, made it, sent myself the link, opened it cold, put it on disk — and every step worked. The list is not empty, but nothing on it is a rebuild.**

![the page I wanted, opened cold from its own link in a fresh browser](shots/cold-from-link-1280.png)

**The six words, with the delta.** simple **3→4** · powerful **5** (=) · organized **5** (=) · intuitive **4** (=) · easy to browse **4→5** · infinite potential **3** (=).

**Your own use, five steps, all five worked.** I wanted *a docs browser I click through as columns, with a properties panel on the right, dense type, on a tinted page* — not one of the twelve. **Set the seven words:** all seven took. **The address:** `?navigation=columns&arrangement=rail-right&content=docs&background=tint&type=compact`. **Sent it to myself:** opened that url in a fresh browser, identical stage, identical seven dropdowns, identical 698×371 box, zero errors. **Made it a file:** `made/paging/page.json` appeared on disk with my seven words, and [it opens cold at its own url](/imagine/paging/make/) with its own bar. (Deleted after — `made/` is byte-identical to where I started.)

**One thing got worse, and it is the button you just promoted.** Press **Code** — tooltip *"the page.js this page would be, ready to copy"* — and you get a dark strip **22px tall holding 352px and nineteen lines**. Half of line one. The fix pass made Code open *on* the code; the box it opens on is collapsed. ([picture](shots/code-button-1280.png))

**What would move `simple` to 5** — a naming pass, no new behaviour. The rail says six blocks, the bar says seven labels (Skin is three of them, Stage is none), and the address bar says `surface`/`background`/`type` where the controls say *content colour* / *page colour* / *type size*. One `SKIN` group, one line on Stage, url keys that match the labels.

**What would move `infinite potential` to 5** — two seams. The nest takes a **preset id**, so only the twelve ready-made pages can go inside a page: *the page I just made cannot*, which is your "put any page inside any other" unmet. And [Cross](/imagine/paging/cross/) is a hard-coded **3×3 out of a possible 7×7** with no control. Let `?nest=` take a url, and give Cross two dropdowns.

**Everything else from my third list is fixed and I re-proved it:** one `page.json` schema, Build's step 4 is Arrangement with all seven values, the drawer says *"the blocks are one column"* before naming layout 1.stack, Code and More are two different drawers, and the Library's grey chip is a labelled dropdown.

**Checked:** 25 pages × 1280 and 3440 = **50 cold loads, zero console errors**, no sideways scroll, every stage box **95–97% painted** at both widths. **Nine items, all S or M** — full ranked list in the log above.
